notes.title: RRoL v1.1 update
notes.content:
RRoL is updated to v1.1, in this version:
- fixed some typos and monir bugs
- polished some details 

Special thanks to the LPers who played the game! 


------------------
About using AA's savedata:
The engine RPG Maker MV has some unknown problems that may cause laggy issues on some PCs.
It [i]may[/i] be laggy when using AA's savedate, especially when you had laggy problems playing AA. It seems that using the old savedata could bring the laggy performance into RR, otherwise RR itself should have a better performance than AA. In that case, it is sugguested to start a new game without using the savedata. 
It looks like a problem depending on each player's PC environment (so is the "header is wrong" problem). I did consider changing the savedata part into a password, but for now it seems okay (seems...), and I prefer to keep the change to minimum since the game is already released... 
Please let me know [b]if you have problems when using AA's savedata, but no running problem when start a new game[/b]. If the problem affect most of the players I'll consider changing this function.

It is recommended to have at leaset an i5 CPU and 8GB RAM to run the game. (i5CPU+16GB RAM, i7CPU+8GB RAM are confirmed to be fine, but still, it is recommended to [i]save frequently[/i].)


------------------
Now that the Art Book is released, the RPG development comes to an end. 
I'll be focusing on Amelia's little adventure in the following weeks, but before that I do need a break. Things are a bit overwhelming, plus my hand hurts very much recently and I can bearly lift my arm. The development will resume when my hand recovers^^;
I'll post more dev updates on Twitter and may stream on Youtube sometimes, please follow and check the SNS if you're interested!
Don't forget to take care of yourself (and drink a lot of water!)

Thank you again for your support and kindness! 
(I'm proud of this project and the art book anyway, and I hope you can enjoy them ːtwtpbearː)
*The [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/survey/the-3rd-popularity-vote/]the 3rd Popularity Vote[/url] is still going on!

See you next time!

notes.title: The Other: Rosie's Road of Love is Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39482228/05a9c6bd60468448de8a2725ac5abaf00709e356.jpg[/img]
Art by Shencao

Hope you enjoy the game!

[h3]About RRoL's interaction with Airi's Adventure's savedata[/h3]
If you have finished the True Ending of Airi's Adventure,
copy [i]global.rpgsave[/i] and [i]config.rpgsave[/i] in AA's local folder to RRoL's save folder,
then you can have the extra contents in your FIRST gameplay.
They're also available after clearing RRoL.

The extra contents (2nd Run or AA savedata) include: 
1) Have extra 300 G (You probably know where it is from if you've played AA X'D)
2) Have some recipes, fishing notes and a Glass Rod.
3) Invite Jo as your party member.

The story happens after Lillian's party has saved world, so you'll see people talking about it...but no AA key spoiler is included in RRoL. Please enjoy it as a new journey~
It doesn't matter if you haven't played AA either. AA will be like a [strike]giant easter egg[/strike] prequel after RRoL. Please play at your own pace!

[spoiler]Personally I think RRoL may be richer in story, and have more fun details (and collectables) and more colourful characters...I'd totally recommend it even if you haven't played AA or TWTPːtwtpteaː[/spoiler]

Aaaaannd some exciting news!

[h3]1) The new official website is online now! [/h3]
Thanks to Vilja (who's also the programmer of T&TR)! 
You can check all the news, game information, walkthroughs on the website, and more contents are planning to be updated.

[h3]2) A Popularity Vote![/h3]
This is going to be [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/survey/the-3rd-popularity-vote/]the 3rd Popularity Vote[/url], to celebrate RRoL's release and T&T's 5 year(!) anniversary. The 1st & 2nd results can be found in the news of the previous games' news. 

* You don't have to play all the games to vote.
* End Date is to be announced, but at least it'll be the end of August. Please take your time playing!


[h3]3) Art Book making and Fan Art Event![/h3]
An Art Book is also going to be made this time, in the following weeks.

Here we have the old fan art event again!
If there is anyone interested in submitting fan art for the Art Book now it's the time~
You'll recieve a copy for free if your art is included in the book!
It’s not a contest (and properly not many submissions) so don't worry, just join if you're interested.
~ [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/event-calling-for-fan-art/]Read the detailed rules here[/url] ~


Thank you very much for your support! It's not easy for a small solo dev. I do appreciate it.
Please take care and have fun playing!ːtwtpbearː
